metrics.name: 引拍 X-factor / 躯干扭转（文献 mean±1SD）
metrics.notes: Mapped from Shan 2016 skilled-group X-factor (trunk rotation) 46.9±11.2°. Literature X-factor is pelvis–shoulder separation in horizontal plane; PoseScorer trunk_coil_backswing is a 2D MediaPipe shoulder-hip line angle proxy (different quantity). Alias intent: trunk_x_factor_prep.

citations.title: Shan et al. Biomechanical analysis of badminton forehand smash (J Hum Kinet 2016)
citations.extracted: Skilled group (SG) X-factor (trunk rotation) mean±SD: 46.9 ± 11.2° → range_min=35.7, range_max=58.1 (mean±1SD).

metrics.notes: Shan 2016 SG wrist flex/ext ROM 85.9±50.4° (mean±1SD would be 35.5–136.3; package uses caution band 40–130). MediaPipe Pose lacks reliable wrist FE; scorer returns null (neutral) — literature range retained for documentation only.
